ARTH 201.name: History of Western Art I
ARTH 201.description: Survey of Western art and architecture from prehistory through the Gothic era.

ARTH 202N.name: History of Western Art II
ARTH 202N.description: Survey of Western art and architecture from the Renaissance to the present.

ARTH 1S.name: First-Year Seminar in Art History
ARTH 1S.description: Introductory seminar for first-year Art History majors.

ARTH 111.name: Ancient to Medieval Art
ARTH 111.description: Survey of Western art from antiquity through the medieval period.

ARTH 101N.name: Introduction to Global Art History
ARTH 101N.description: Survey of non-Western art traditions across cultures and time periods.

ARTH 350W.name: Undergraduate Seminar in the History of Art
ARTH 350W.description: Capstone seminar: introduction to original research, methodology, analysis, and writing on a scholarly level. Bulletin requires fourth-semester standing and 6 credits of ARTH coursework, which the planner schema does not model directly as course-specific prereqs -- by the plan's own Semester 6 placement, ARTH 1S/111/101N are already long completed.
